entries.title: Job 23:2
segments: Even today [is] my complaint bitter; my stroke is heavier than my groaning.

entries.title: Job 23:3
segments: Oh that I knew [where] I might find Him, [that] I might come even to His seat!

entries.title: Job 23:4
segments: I would order [my] cause before Him, and fill my mouth with arguments.

entries.title: Job 23:5
segments: I would know the words [which] He would answer me, and understand what He would say to me.

entries.title: Job 23:6
segments: Will He plead against me with [His] great power? No, surely He would give heed to me.

entries.title: Job 23:7
segments: There the righteous might reason with Him; and I would be delivered forever from my Judge.

entries.title: Job 23:8
segments: Behold, I go forward, but He is not [there]; and backward, but I cannot see Him;

entries.title: Job 23:9
segments: on the left hand, where He works, but I cannot behold Him. He turns to the right, but I do not see [Him].

entries.title: Job 23:10
segments: But He knows the way that I take; [when] He has tried me, I shall come forth as gold.

entries.title: Job 23:11
segments: My foot has held fast in His steps; I have kept His way, and have not fallen away;

entries.title: Job 23:12
segments: nor have I gone back from the commandment of His lips; I treasured the words of His mouth more than my portion.

entries.title: Job 23:13
segments: But He [is] in one [mind], and who can turn Him? Yea, what His soul desires, He does [it].

entries.title: Job 23:14
segments: For He fulfilled my lot, and many [things] like these are with Him.

entries.title: Job 23:15
segments: Therefore I am troubled at His presence; when I look, I am afraid of Him.

entries.title: Job 23:16
segments: For God makes my heart soft, and the Almighty troubles me;

entries.title: Job 23:17
segments: because I was not cut off before the darkness; yea, He covered the darkness from my face.
